title: Wayfare Pass Late-Posting Goodwill on Ride Credit — Desk Guidance
content:
# Late-posting goodwill on Pass ride credit — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

## Rule the desk applies

The late-posting goodwill rewards the wait for credit that was due 48 hours after drop-off: 1.00 when the posting is made 5 or more calendar days after the drop-off date, 0.50 when it is made 3 or 4 days after, nothing when it is made sooner.

The goodwill is added to the trip's Pass ride credit when the credit worked out for the trip is above 0.00, after the per-trip cap and the monthly cap have been applied, and is not itself limited by them; the total is rounded half up to the cent. A trip whose credit comes to 0.00 receives no goodwill.

## Counting the days

Calendar days from the drop-off date of the trip, as its trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares) shows it, to the date the credit is posted.

| Calendar days from drop-off date to posting | Goodwill (USD) |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | 1.00 |
| 3 or 4 | 0.50 |
| 0 to 2 | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- Drop-off on 10 May, posting on 15 May: 5 days, 1.00. Posting on 14 May: 4 days, 0.50.
- Drop-off on 10 May, posting on 13 May: 3 days, 0.50. Posting on 12 May: 2 days, nothing.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A trip whose credit comes to 1.80, posted 6 days after its drop-off date, is posted at 2.80. The same trip with credit of 0.00 because the monthly cap had no room is posted at nothing; the goodwill does not attach.
